newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ECON MIN, CENTRAL BANKER MEET OVER 97 MONEY POLICY.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ECON MIN, CENTRAL BANKER MEET OVER 97 MONEY POLICY.

text.p: Greece's National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou met with Bank of Greece Governor Lucas Papademos and Deputy Governors Nickos Garganas and Takis Thomopoulos and discussed monetary policy for 1997, ministry officials told Reuters.
The minister and the central bank officials declined to make any comment after the meeting.
The new year's monetary policy is expected to be announced in late January. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
